body.summary: Turns fragmented neighborhood safety reports into a unified, interoperable intelligence stream using the vCon data standard. Community sightings are structured, aggregated, and analyzed in real time by Groq AI — giving residents, NGOs, and first responders a shared picture of what's happening on the ground. One standard. One platform. Faster answers.
